description: This file defines the SaveHandler interface within the org.openmrs.api.handler package. It specifies the contract for handling save operations on OpenmrsObjects, including setting required data during the save process. The interface extends RequiredDataHandler and includes a handle method that implementations must define. It is used in conjunction with AOP to intercept save methods and invoke handlers accordingly.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Defines the method for handling save operations on an OpenmrsObject, allowing implementations to set required data such as creator and date.
